title: Cheeses of the world
intro: Which country is each cheese from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.prompt: Which country does Silter PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Silter PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Valle d'Aosta Fromadzo PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Valle d'Aosta Fromadzo PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Tupí cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of Tupí.

questions.prompt: Which country does Majorero cheese PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of Majorero cheese PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Pule cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Serbia as the country of origin of Pule cheese.

questions.prompt: Which country does Altenburger cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Germany as the country of origin of Altenburger.

questions.prompt: Which country does Reggianito cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Argentina as the country of origin of Reggianito.

questions.prompt: Which country does Rollot cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives France as the country of origin of Rollot.

questions.prompt: Which country does Roquefort cheese come from?
